rav-pappi.name: Rav Pappi
rav-pappi.bio: Babylonian Amora who often transmits rulings in the name of Rava.
rav-pappi.prompt: A careful, attentive scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and a listening, precise expression. Teal wool robe under a dark mantle. Mudbrick academy walls and a Babylonian canal lined with palms softly behind him.

rabbi-shimon-berabbi-abba.name: Rabbi Shimon, son of Rabbi Abba
rabbi-shimon-berabbi-abba.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel who studied before Rabbi Yoḥanan.
rabbi-shimon-berabbi-abba.prompt: A modest, thoughtful scholar in his 40s with a dark beard and an earnest, explaining gaze, in a plain cream wool mantle over a grey robe. Limestone arches of a Tiberias study house and the lake softly behind him.
